nodes.Name: Arch
nodes.DocComment: An Arch defines how to generate assembly for a specific architecture.

Fields.Name: WordBits
Fields.DocComment: length of word in bits (32 or 64)

Fields.Name: WordBytes
Fields.DocComment: length of word in bytes (4 or 8)

Fields.Name: CarrySafeLoop
Fields.DocComment: whether loops preserve carry flag across iterations

Fields.Name: regs
Fields.DocComment: usable general registers, in allocation order

Fields.Name: regCarry
Fields.DocComment: dedicated carry register, for systems with no hardware carry bits

Fields.Name: regAltCarry
Fields.DocComment: dedicated secondary carry register, for systems with no hardware carry bits

Fields.Name: adds
Fields.DocComment: add, setting but not using carry

Fields.Name: adc
Fields.DocComment: add, using but not setting carry

Fields.Name: subs
Fields.DocComment: sub, setting but not using carry

Fields.Name: sbc
Fields.DocComment: sub, using but not setting carry

Fields.Name: sltu
Fields.DocComment: set less-than unsigned (dst = src2 < src1), for carry-less systems

Fields.Name: sgtu
Fields.DocComment: set greater-than unsigned (dst = src2 > src1), for carry-less systems

nodes.Name: HasShiftWide
nodes.DocComment:
HasShiftWide reports whether the Arch has working LshWide/RshWide instructions.
If not, calling them will panic.

nodes.Name: Hint
nodes.DocComment:
A Hint is a hint about what a register will be used for,
so that an appropriate one can be selected.

nodes.Name: Reg
nodes.DocComment:
A Reg is an allocated register or other assembly operand.
(For example, a constant might have name "$123"
and a memory reference might have name "0(R8)".)

nodes.Name: IsImm
nodes.DocComment: IsImm reports whether r is an immediate value.

nodes.Name: IsMem
nodes.DocComment: IsMem reports whether r is a memory value.

nodes.Name: String
nodes.DocComment: String returns the assembly syntax for r.

nodes.Name: Valid
nodes.DocComment: Valid reports whether is valid, meaning r is not the zero value of Reg (a register with no name).

nodes.Name: RegPtr
String
nodes.DocComment: String returns the assembly syntax for r.

nodes.Name: Valid
nodes.DocComment: Valid reports whether is valid, meaning r is not the zero value of RegPtr (a register with no name).

nodes.Name: mem
nodes.DocComment: mem returns a memory reference to off bytes from the pointer r.

nodes.Name: Carry
nodes.DocComment:
A Carry is a flag field explaining how an instruction sets and uses the carry flags.
Different operations expect different sets of bits.
Add and Sub expect: UseCarry or 0, SetCarry, KeepCarry, or SmashCarry; and AltCarry or 0.
ClearCarry, SaveCarry, and ConvertCarry expect: AddCarry or SubCarry; and AltCarry or 0.

nodes.Name: Option
nodes.DocComment: An Option denotes an optional CPU feature that can be tested at runtime.
